mission: Make Fitness Pals feel physically alive, human, cinematic, and coach-present without weakening athlete truth, privacy, accessibility, or performance.

phases.name: Vital Blueprint
phases.purpose: Define the measurable production blueprint and integration boundaries.

phases.name: Human Heat
phases.purpose: Replace abstract athlete illustration with genuine cinematic adult-athlete imagery.

phases.name: Amanda Alive
phases.purpose: Reuse the separately deployed myChat Amanda capability through a narrow, resilient service boundary.

phases.name: Sonic Impact
phases.purpose: Replace thin oscillator chirps with a restrained physical sonic language.

phases.name: Kinetic Cinema
phases.purpose: Choreograph motion, depth, and transitions around athlete intent and evidence.

phases.name: Embodied Athlete
phases.purpose: Carry human imagery and physical storytelling through authenticated athlete surfaces.

phases.name: Living World
phases.purpose: Converge media, Amanda, motion, sound, responsive behavior, resilience, and production proof.

humanHeat.current: Stylized athlete SVG reused across key surfaces.
humanHeat.target: Cinematic adult women and men in believable athletic motion, with responsive art direction and readable negative space.

amandaAlive.current: Fitness-Pals-local visual presence plus browser SpeechRecognition and speechSynthesis progressive enhancement.
amandaAlive.target: Separately deployed myChat Amanda reused through an explicit Fitness-Pals integration adapter while the existing text Coach remains a non-blocking fallback.

sonicImpact.target: Designed, restrained physical cues that reinforce visible user-initiated state changes.

kineticCinema.current: Mostly opacity/transform UI motion and static hero composition.
kineticCinema.target: Purposeful choreography for entry, continuity, progress, and earned moments, with reduced-motion equivalence.

composition.current: Repeated cards and similar surface treatments flatten emotional hierarchy.
composition.target: Editorial composition that alternates human imagery, athlete evidence, whitespace, scale, and focused calls to action.

requirements: copy-safe negative space must be planned per breakpoint
mobile crops must be art-directed rather than accidental
alt text must describe meaningful content without body judgment
athlete data and product purpose remain primary
avoid: sexualized camera framing disconnected from sport

amandaArchitecture.identityBoundary: A Fitness-Pals login is not silently treated as a myChat biometric/profile credential. Any profile association must be explicit, server-mediated, least-privilege, revocable, and auditable.
amandaArchitecture.fallback: If myChat, voice authentication, speech transport, or private profile access is unavailable, existing Fitness-Pals text Coach remains usable and Amanda must visibly degrade instead of blocking coaching.

phase1Acceptance.name: Human Heat
must: replace the abstract landing-page athlete SVG as the primary hero with genuine cinematic adult-athlete imagery
represent at least one adult woman athlete and one adult man athlete across the primary Human Heat composition
provide breakpoint-aware desktop and mobile art direction
preserve readable copy, primary authentication path, Amanda cue, and athlete-proof hierarchy
pass reduced-motion, keyboard, contrast, alt-text, and no-fabricated-metric checks
mustNot: change athlete data or coaching recommendation semantics
introduce autoplay audio or autoplay background video
